CustomField.description: Admission Year set on every new Zoom session (created by webhook or sync) when it has none. Must be a Zoom Session Admission Year value, e.g. Admission Year - 2027. Blank or invalid = no default (the new-session setup email is sent).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: e.g. Admission Year - 2027. Applied only to new sessions.
CustomField.label: Default Admission Year
